entities.title: zazzle investigate --adaptive
entities.summary: The adaptive mode of `zazzle investigate` (`--adaptive`, `--agents`, `--orchestrator`, `--orchestrator-effort`, `--prose`, `--json`) and its review (`--review-model`, `--review-effort`) and benchmark (`--benchmark-model`, `--benchmark-effort`): each part of a question runs on the cheapest agent and effort that will do it, and an unsettled part goes up the ladder with what it established.
entities.purpose: mod.rs separates its flags from investigate's, builds the ladder (agent.rs: `MODEL`, `local:`, `claude:` or `codex:` specs, each `@EFFORT` or at low then high; by default the installed local models from `ai-agent status --json`, smallest first), rates the question 0 to 5 without a model and, above 0, asks a planner one rung above the difficulty for at most four `PART n | question | symbols` lines (a planner that fails, gives no parts, rates its understanding low or asks to escalate is replaced by the next rung once). Each part runs on its rung: a local rung through investigate's lookup loop (explore and work, with --context for what an earlier attempt established), a hosted rung as one read-only `claude -p` or `codex exec` call whose reply lines are parsed and whose citations are checked (work.rs). A part escalates on a failure, a request to escalate, a low rating, rejected citations only or nothing verified, at most three times, never past the top or the time limit, and never when it is blocked on the user. With --orchestrator (any agent spec, usually claude: or codex:) it alone plans, with no ladder planner after it, combines and writes the --prose summary; otherwise the planner combines and the cheapest rung summarizes. The combiner cites only lines the parts verified, else they are merged. The review and the benchmark (alongside the main run when hosted) each get --seconds; every report ends with the usage per role, an `orchestration` JSON object listing every step with its agent and tokens in and out, the orchestrator's apart from the delegated agents', and each adaptive run appends a text-free record to the orchestration log (record.rs).
boundaries: Read-only: hosted agents run with Read, Grep and Glob only (claude, dontAsk) or a read-only sandbox (codex); local rungs use investigate's read-only lookups.
Only citations are checked, never claims; the report says the claims are the models'.
Hosted agents run only when --agents, --review-model or --benchmark-model names them; nothing is downloaded.
Local calls share daemon's one worker, so local parts run one after another.
